title: Set 91

sentences.ko: 여동생이 2천 달러만 빌려 달라는데 아직 답을 안 했어. 답을 안 한 게 사실상 답이지. 그만한 돈이 없어서가 아니야. 저번에 갚기는 갚았는데 세 달 있다가 또 빌려 달라더라고. 이게 우리 사이에 으레 하는 일이 될 바에는 차라리 그 돈을 떼이는 게 나아. 그래서 거절 아닌 것처럼 거절하는 방법을 계속 궁리하는 중이야. 너 같으면 어떻게 하겠어?
sentences.text: My sister asked me for two thousand dollars and I still haven't answered her, which is basically an answer. I can afford it, that's not the problem. It's that she paid me back last time and then asked again three months later, and I'd rather just lose the money than have this be a thing we do now. So I keep trying to figure out how to say no in a way that isn't no. What would you even do with that?

alts.text: So my sister hit me up for two thousand dollars and I still haven't gotten back to her, which is kind of an answer already. I can afford it, that's not the issue. It's that she paid me back last time and then came asking again three months later, and honestly I'd rather just be out the money than have this turn into a thing we do now. So I keep trying to work out how to say no in a way that isn't no. What would you even do with that?

My sister has asked me for two thousand dollars and I still have not responded to her, which is in itself a response. I am able to afford it; that is not the problem. The difficulty is that she repaid me last time and then asked again three months later, and I would rather simply lose the money than allow this to become something we do regularly. So I keep trying to determine how to decline in a way that is not a refusal. What would you do in that situation?

sentences.note: **I'd rather just lose the money than have this be a thing we do now** 는 이게 우리 사이의 습관처럼 굳어지느니 차라리 돈을 떼이겠다는 뜻입니다. **a thing we do** 처럼 thing 하나로 되풀이되는 관계의 패턴을 가리킬 수 있습니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 열한 시에 누웠고 딱 하나만 확인하려고 폰을 열었거든. 그런데 정신 차려 보니 새벽 한 시고, 웨일스에 사는 어떤 남자가 시멘트도 없이 돌담 쌓는 걸 보고 있는 거야. 나 돌담에 관심 없어! 살면서 돌담 생각 한 번 해 본 적 없어. 게다가 여섯 시에 일어나야 했다고! 내가 나한테 일부러 그 짓을 한 거지.
sentences.text: I got in bed at eleven and I only opened my phone to check one thing, and then it's one in the morning and I'm watching a guy in Wales build a stone wall with no cement. I don't care about walls! I have never once thought about a wall. And I had to be up at six! I did that to myself on purpose.

alts.text: So I'm in bed by eleven and I only open my phone for one quick thing, and next thing I know it's one in the morning and I'm watching some guy in Wales build a stone wall with no cement. I don't care about walls! I have never once thought about a wall. And I had to be up at six! I did that to myself on purpose.

I went to bed at eleven and I only opened my phone to check one thing, and then it was one in the morning and I was watching a man in Wales building a stone wall without cement. I have no interest in walls. I have never once given a wall any thought. And I had to be awake at six. I did that to myself deliberately.

sentences.note: **I have never once thought about a wall** 의 never once 는 단 한 번도 없다고 힘주어 말할 때 씁니다. **I did that to myself on purpose** 는 누가 시킨 것도 아니고 알면서 스스로 자초했다는 자책입니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 금요일 4시 40분에 배달 완료라고 뜨는데 여기 아무것도 없어. 양쪽 옆집에 다 물어봤고, 화분 뒤도 봤고, 아무도 안 쓰는 옆문까지 확인했어. 전화할 때마다 배송 조회에 뜨는 내용을 나한테 그대로 읽어 주기만 해. 내가 사흘째 그것만 들여다보고 있는 줄도 모르는 것처럼. 그래서 그냥 의자를 다시 사야 할 것 같아. 엄마가 18일에 오시는데 엄마 드리려고 산 거거든.
sentences.text: It says delivered at 4:40 on Friday and there's nothing here. I asked both my neighbors, I looked behind the planter, I checked the side door that nobody even uses. And every time I call they just read the tracking back to me, like I haven't been staring at it for three days. So I think I'm just going to have to buy the chair again, because my mom gets in on the eighteenth and it was for her.

alts.text: Tracking says delivered 4:40 Friday and there's nothing here. I asked both neighbors, I looked behind the planter, I checked the side door nobody even uses. And every time I call they just read the tracking back at me, like I haven't been staring at it for three days. So I'm gonna have to just buy the chair again, cause my mom gets in on the eighteenth and it was for her.

It states that it was delivered at 4:40 on Friday, and there is nothing here. I asked both of my neighbors, I looked behind the planter, and I checked the side door that nobody even uses. And every time I call, they simply read the tracking information back to me, as though I have not been staring at it for three days. So I believe I will have to purchase the chair again, because my mother arrives on the eighteenth and it was intended for her.

sentences.note: **read the tracking back to me** 는 내가 이미 다 본 조회 내용을 상대가 그대로 다시 읽어 주기만 한다는 뜻입니다. **my mom gets in on the eighteenth** 의 get in 은 도착한다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 우리 금요일에 갔다 왔는데, 갈비 얘기는 진짜 과장이 아니었어. 어제도 그 갈비 생각이 또 나더라. 그런데 시끄럽다는 얘기는 왜 안 해 줬어! 남편이랑 나랑 한 시간 반 동안 서로 고개만 끄덕였잖아. 그래도 또 갈 거야. 대신 노인들처럼 다섯 시에 가려고.
sentences.text: Okay, so we went Friday and you were not exaggerating about the short ribs, I thought about them again yesterday. But you didn't warn me about the noise! My husband and I basically just nodded at each other for an hour and a half. We're definitely going back, we're just going at five like old people.

alts.text: So we ended up going Friday and yeah, you were not kidding about the short ribs, I was still thinking about them yesterday. But you didn't warn me about the noise! Me and my husband basically just nodded at each other for an hour and a half. We're definitely going back, we're just gonna go at five like old people.

We went on Friday, and you were not exaggerating about the short ribs; I found myself thinking of them again yesterday. However, you did not warn me about the noise. My husband and I essentially just nodded at one another for an hour and a half. We will certainly return, though we will be going at five, like elderly people.

sentences.note: **you were not exaggerating** 은 네 말이 과장이 아니라 정말 그렇더라는 뜻이고, casual 의 **you were not kidding** 도 같은 말입니다. **you didn't warn me about the noise** 처럼 미리 말해 주지 그랬냐고 가볍게 타박할 때 warn 을 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 봉투에 다른 사람 이름이 적혀 있고 안에는 전부 초밥이야. 나는 매주 시켜 먹는 그 치킨을 시켰는데. 전화했더니 제대로 된 걸 보내 주겠다면서 사십 분이 더 걸린대. 그래서 그냥 초밥 먹고 있어. 그쯤 되니까 아무래도 상관없어지더라고. 아들은 아주 신났어. 원래 이런 식으로 되는 건 줄 알아.
sentences.text: The bag had somebody else's name on it and it's all sushi, but I ordered the chicken thing I get every week. I called and they said they'd send the right order but it'd be another forty minutes, so we're just eating the sushi, because at that point I stopped caring. My son is thrilled. He thinks this is how it works now.

alts.text: So there's somebody else's name on the bag and it's all sushi, but I ordered the chicken thing I get every week. I called and they said they'd send the right one but it'd be another forty minutes, so we're just eating the sushi, cause by then I'd stopped caring. My son is thrilled. He thinks this is how it works now.

The bag had someone else's name on it and it contained nothing but sushi, but I had ordered the chicken dish that I get every week. I called, and they said they would send the correct order, but that it would be another forty minutes, so we are simply eating the sushi, because by that point I had stopped caring. My son is delighted. He believes this is how it works now.

sentences.note: **I stopped caring** 는 더 따지기를 포기하고 될 대로 되라 싶어졌다는 뜻입니다. **My son is thrilled** 의 thrilled 는 아주 신나고 좋아 죽겠다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 1번 casual: "eat the money" 는 원어민이 쓰는 꼴이 아닙니다 (돈을 떠안을 때는 eat the cost/be out the money). "be out the money" 로 고쳤습니다.
1번 casual: "wants two thousand dollars off me" 의 off me 는 영국식이라 미국 구어로는 어색합니다. "hit me up for two thousand dollars" 로 바꿔 casual 다운 시작이 되게 했습니다.
